title: Work-tape cell flags
statement: Given natural numbers $s,j$, a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on a Boolean input, and a work-tape index $i$, associate to the cell at position $j-s$ the three Boolean flags indicating, respectively, that the cell contains false, that it contains true, and that the work-tape head is at that position.
hypotheses_covered: a configuration on a Boolean input
a work-tape index $i$ among the machine's $k$ work tapes
